# IFG for Google Antigravity

**Official tax law, as at the date of the taxable event**, directly inside your AI agent, with applicability status, historical versions and clickable links to each official publisher. IFG is a documentary research infrastructure: it delivers exact official texts while the legal analysis stays yours.

## Coverage

IFG serves official tax publishers across **32 European jurisdictions** (all **27 EU Member States**, **Switzerland** and its 26 cantons, the **United Kingdom** and devolved nations, **Monaco**, **Andorra** and its parishes, **Liechtenstein**, plus **French overseas territories**), **Israel**, **EU tax law**, **OECD Model Commentaries**, the **UN Model**, and **2,389 bilateral tax treaties** with protocols and MLI effects.

- **Exact official wording**: codes, statutes, administrative doctrine, rulings, case law, forms and parliamentary history, each with a direct official publisher link.
- **Point-in-time reading**: retrieve the version applicable on the date of the taxable event, with past and announced future versions.
- **Quote verification**: `check_sources` verifies every quoted excerpt word for word against the official text at that date.
- **Honest gaps**: missing or unproven texts are reported explicitly, never invented.

## What this plugin includes

- **Remote MCP server (`ifg`)** at `https://ifg.tax/v1/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, dynamic client registration and client ID metadata documents). Eight tools: `search_authority`, `get_authority`, `browse_instrument`, `cross_border_sources`, `changes_since`, `check_sources`, `coverage` (all read-only) and `report_issue`.
- **Skill `tax-research`** (`/tax-research`): research methodology for finding official provisions at the relevant date, resolving cross-border treaty and domestic links, and verifying citations.
- **Skill `setup`** (`/setup`): sign-in, OAuth setup and connection check.

## Installation

Install directly from GitHub with the Antigravity CLI:

```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/aitorgarcia21/ifg-antigravity-plugin
```

Then authorize the `ifg` MCP server once in Antigravity (OAuth 2.1 browser sign-in). An IFG account is required: 7-day free trial, no credit card required; when the trial ends, access simply stops unless you subscribe.

- Website: https://ifg.tax
- Connect guide: https://ifg.tax/connect
- Security: https://ifg.tax/security
- Technical specification: https://ifg.tax/ifg-mcp-specification.pdf
- Privacy policy: https://ifg.tax/privacy-policy
- Support: contact@ifg.tax

# IFG pour Google Antigravity

**Tout le droit fiscal officiel, à la date du fait générateur**, directement dans votre agent IA, avec statut d’applicabilité, versions historiques datées et lien cliquable vers l’éditeur officiel.

- **Périmètre** : 32 États européens (les 27 États membres de l’Union européenne, la Suisse et ses cantons, le Royaume-Uni, Monaco, Andorre, le Liechtenstein et l’outre-mer français), Israël, le droit fiscal de l’Union européenne, les commentaires du Modèle OCDE, le Modèle ONU et 2 389 conventions fiscales bilatérales avec leurs avenants et effets MLI.
- **Serveur MCP distant** (`https://ifg.tax/v1/mcp`, Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 avec PKCE), 8 outils dont `cross_border_sources` et `check_sources`.
- **Essai gratuit de 7 jours, sans carte bancaire** : à la fin de l’essai, sans abonnement, l’accès s’arrête simplement sans frais. Site : https://ifg.tax · Contact : contact@ifg.tax
